payload.rationale: The permit text at page 5 part_i establishes that this facility uses ultraviolet disinfection and that TRC shall be monitored only when chlorine is used within the treatment plant, which is conditional monitoring rather than routine UV-plant effluent monitoring. The cover-page effective dates (2021-12-01 through 2026-11-30) place Federal FY2025 within the permit term, so that conditional rule governs TRC for the requested period. Month-specific whether monitoring was required in FY2025 remains unresolved without chlorine-use operational evidence (noted in known_missing_information), but the packet does establish that the conditional monitoring regime applies to this permit and parameter.
